title: Chapter 323 Number One On The Immortal Emperor Ranking
content:
Chapter 323 Number One On The Immortal Emperor Ranking

Everyone immediately looked at the source of the sound.

I saw that it was a woman in blue with a temperamental temperament, with her moving eyes staring at Old Gui Chen in the distance.

Lu Xue!

At this moment, all the powerful people of the Xiao clan stood in front of Lu Xue, staring at Old Gui Chen in the distance with an unkind look.

"You? Just rely on you?!"

When he saw Lu Xue, he was still a little surprised, but when he found that Lu Xue only had the Immortal Saint Realm, he was furious.

Immortal Saint Realm kills his son in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Do you really think he is stupid?

"You think I can't do it?"

Lu Xue asked back.

At this moment, except for the people who just came out of the ancient battlefield who believed Lu Xue's words, the rest of them were a little unbelievable.

Even the Xiao clan members are the same.

No matter how evil Miss Lu is, she is not so evil.

I can only say that their vision is still too short.

Old Gui Chen in the distance stared at Lu Xue without saying anything, which was self-evident.

Seeing this, Lu Xue shook her head slightly, and then the Xuanyuan Sword appeared in her hand and pointed at Ye Tian among the Ye tribe.

"You, come out and fight one-on-one."

Seeing Lu Xue pointing at him, Ye Tian was slightly stunned when he was watching the show happily, and then he was furious.

"Do you know what you're talking about?"

"I am the first in the Ye tribe,"

"Stop talking nonsense, I'm going to hit you."

......

At this moment, Ye Tian's face was extremely gloomy.

"Okay, this is what you asked for."

Although I don’t understand why Lu Xue suddenly wanted to fight him alone, it doesn’t matter, it’s just a matter of action.

A realm of immortal saint is not enough for him.

"Take it, otherwise you will have no chance."

Looking at Lu Xue not far away in front of him, Ye Tian said proudly.

Facing an immortal holy realm, he even had no desire to take action.

Lu Xue didn't say anything nonsense about this.

Buzz —

The sword sounded suddenly.

The next moment.

Bang!

Ye Tian's figure flew backwards and lost consciousness directly.

If it weren't for the body protection treasure, this sword could have even taken Ye Tian's life.

At this moment, the scene fell into silence again.

It was not until the Ye tribe's strong men reacted that the calm was broken.

"Young Master Ye Tian!"

At this moment, Lu Xue has already been reborn, and even Chen Mingyu and Lu Xue who have taken the Violent Pill can deal with him.

Facing Ye Tian, who was still in the early stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, Lu Xue was not under pressure at all.

Even because of Ye Tian's carelessness, he didn't even take a single move.

At this time, Lu Xue slowly turned around and looked at Old Gui Chen in the distance, as if she had just done something very casual.

"Now, have you believed it?"

Upon hearing this, Old Gui Chen nodded slightly, "I believe it."

In an instant, a terrifying murderous intent surged out of Chen Laogui's body and swept towards Lu Xue in the distance.

At this moment, the powerful people of the Xiao clan immediately came out and surrounded Lu Xue.

"Old Gui Chen, what do you want to do!"

"Whoever is surnamed Chen, do you want to be an enemy of my Xiao clan??"

Faced with the shock of the Xiao clan, Old Ghost Chen looked ferocious, "Class Chief Xiao, she is not a member of your Xiao clan. Do you really want to do this for a foreign clan?!

Upon hearing this, Xiao Mo said coldly: "She is indeed not a member of my Xiao tribe, but I, Xiao tribe, are willing to use the lives of the whole tribe to protect it!"

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

Who was that woman? The Xiao clan would rather offend a peak-level strong man in the Immortal Emperor realm than protect her.

Old Gui Chen was very angry and laughed, "Okay, it's so good, but, can you Xiao clan bear my anger?"

"You can keep it for a while, but you can't keep it for a lifetime!"

At this moment, Tang Hao suddenly said, "Old Gui Chen, your son was not killed by her alone."

Hearing this, Old Gui Chen suddenly looked towards him.

Tang Hao said indifferently: "I took action, too."

Immediately, everyone behind Tang Hao waited for the Tiandi Academy to echo: "I've taken action too."

"And I."

"Haha, it's the last stab I stabbed."

...

On the other side, a voice came from the Chu clan, "And I am."

Chu Lingsheng stood up and said.

In response to this, Old Gui Chen nodded wildly as if he was crazy, "Okay, okay, everyone should take action, don't worry, you all will be retaliated by me."

At this time, Old Gui Chen did not notice that the atmosphere around him was not right.

Almost except for the Ye tribe, the strong men's eyes at Old Gui with great discomfort.

However, they still dare not take action.

Because once Chen Laogui escapes, they will really suffer a terrifying revenge.

Revenge from a peak strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

They were not sure that they would kill Chen Laogui, and they were really afraid to take action.

At this time, Chen Laogui looked straight at Lu Xue regardless of everyone's gaze, and said hoarsely: "I will kill you, no one can stop me."

He relied on the fact that everyone dared not take action, so he acted a little recklessly.

However, the words just ended.

The void suddenly trembled.

Immediately afterwards, an extremely domineering voice came from the void with an unquestionable aura.

"You are worthy of killing me?"

Buzz —

Suddenly, the whole world began to tremble.

Under the shocked gaze of everyone, the void suddenly cracked.

A woman in a long ink dress slowly walked out of it, with three thousand black hairs like a waterfall, and her delicate face was extremely cold at this moment. Her deep eyes looked at Old Gui Chen below, as if she was staring at a dead person .

"Xiao Yin!"

"Sister Xiao Yin!"

Everyone was stunned when they saw the woman.

The person in front of me was Xiao Yin, who was once the top of the evil spirit.

But, isn’t Xiao Yin on the list of battle against the Immortal Emperors?

How did it appear here, could it be?

Suddenly, all the peak Immortal Emperor Realm present looked up at the void at almost the same time.

I saw that the hazy immortal list had changed at this moment.

The number one person is Xiao Yin!

The first place in the Immortal Emperor List!

He is worthy of being the monster Xiao Yin, and he scored another top spot.

And it's the list of Immortal Emperors.

If the top of the previous Monster List only shocked everyone in the Immortal World, then the top of the Immortal Emperor List is to look up to everyone in the Immortal World.

Xiao Yin is truly at the top of the fairy world.

As long as the strong people above the Immortal Emperor Realm do not come out, Xiao Yin is almost invincible.

The Xiao clan is so terrifying!

At this moment, a terrifying look appeared on Mr. Chen's face for the first time.

Because, he was beaten up by a strong man on the Immortal Emperor List that year, and he was defeated miserably in that battle.

And the other party is only seventh.

Without hesitation, Old Gui Chen broke through the space and disappeared from the spot.

He ran away.

"No, Xiao Yin, don't let him escape!"

Xiao Mo yelled.

Li Changqing and the powerful Chu clan also looked gloomy.

Seeing this, Xiao Yin sneered, "It's too late to run away."

As Xiao Yin fled toward Chen Laogui, he punched him.

Billions of fist lights surged in with a destructive aura.

Suddenly, the entire space began to stir up.

The next moment, under the shocked eyes of everyone, Old Gui Chen felt a figure emerge from the crack in the space.

"This, this is impossible!"

At this time, Xiao Yin had already rushed towards Old Gui Chen.

Next, you will have to be beaten unilaterally.

Everyone thought it would be a group beating Chen Laogui, but they never expected that this would happen after Xiao Yin appeared.

The battle between the peak powerful people in the Immortal Emperor Realm should not be like this.

"Wait, wait a moment, Ben, I will not take revenge anymore, I will not take revenge anymore."

"Give me your life, spare me your life."

I don’t know how long it took, Old Gui Chen was already dying, but what greeted him was Xiao Yin’s fatal attack.

He is worthy of being the peak powerhouse of the Immortal Emperor Realm. Not only is he strong in strength, but his vitality is also so tenacious.

Even Xiao Yin was unable to kill Chen Laogui in a short period of time.

It was obvious that Xiao Yin was really trying to kill him.

Old Gui Chen dared not hesitate any more.

boom!

With a loud bang, Old Ghost Chen's body exploded, and then his soul was about to take the opportunity to escape.

But the strong people around are not just for a good meal.

With the attacks of the powerful, Chen Laogui, who was already seriously injured and in his soul, naturally had no power to fight back.

In this way, a generation of strong men died on the road to avenge their son.

The middle way collapsed before revenge.
